about.title: Building the neighbourhood economy with
about.lead: Connecting neighbours, empowering local shops, and building a circular community - together.
intro: At Vicinity24, we believe the strongest communities grow when neighbours, shop owners, and local residents work together. Our goal is simple: no sale lost, no customer left disappointed, and no useful item sitting idle when someone nearby needs it.

That belief comes to life through two connected platforms: v24mart helps local retailers cooperate around real-time inventory, and v24Pool helps people and businesses borrow and lend useful items nearby.
about.projectsSubtitle: Each platform solves a different neighbourhood problem, but both strengthen local commerce, reduce waste, and keep value circulating nearby.

projects.label: v24mart
projects.title: Smarter inventory sharing for local shops
projects.description: v24mart lets nearby retailers share real-time stock so an out-of-stock moment does not become a lost customer. A shop can check a partner store, reserve the item, and keep the sale inside the local business network.
points: Check partner stock in real time
Reserve items across nearby stores
Keep customers loyal to local shops

projects.label: v24Pool
projects.title: Borrow and lend within your neighbourhood
projects.description: v24Pool is a local borrowing marketplace for people, freelancers, and businesses that want access without unnecessary ownership. Instead of buying rarely used items, neighbours can share what already exists and extend the life of every useful asset.
points: Borrow seldom-used items close to home
Earn from idle tools and equipment
Reduce waste and unnecessary purchases

about.visionTitle: A circular neighbourhood economy that works for everyone
about.visionDescription: We do not deny competition; we reject the idea that it must be zero-sum. We are building a model where local businesses cooperate when it matters, households reuse what already exists, and the community becomes stronger with every shared transaction.
visionPrinciples: No sale is lost because shops choose to cooperate instead of competing blindly.
No customer is left unhappy because the local business community has their back.
No usable item is thrown away while someone nearby is about to buy the same thing new.
